tickets.summary: Add pagination to search results API
tickets.description: The search results API currently returns all matching results in a single response. For queries with many results (>100), this causes high memory usage and slow response times. Implement offset/limit pagination with a maximum page size of 50. The response should include total_count, page, page_size, and has_next fields in a pagination metadata object.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* GET /api/v1/search accepts `page` (default 1) and `page_size` (default 20, max 50) query params
* Response includes pagination metadata: { total_count, page, page_size, has_next }
* Requests with page_size > 50 return 400 with descriptive error
* Empty result set returns 200 with empty items array and total_count: 0
* Pagination works correctly with all existing filter combinations
* Performance: 95th percentile response time < 200ms for page 1 of a 10k result set
tickets.test_plan: Unit: pagination offset calculation, boundary validation. Integration: Elasticsearch query with pagination params, verify correct subset returned. E2E: paginate through a 500-item result set, verify no duplicates or gaps. Load test: concurrent paginated queries.
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: offset/limit pagination for search API. Out of scope: cursor-based pagination (future iteration), search result caching (separate ticket PLAT-444), UI pagination controls.
